add.label: New document
add.note: Opens a new untitled document of the kind named, a log or a script (.6cs), as a tab beside the live session's (ADR-D01.79). It writes no file and changes no live state; the untitled buffer is kept in the open-document inventory until it is saved or closed (revision 6, R-3). Its default key comes with the keymap, not from 0.4.

add.label: Open document
add.note: Reads a log or a script file into a tab (ADR-D01.79). It changes no live state and runs no script (ADR-D01.82). A log opens read-only with no binding, scrub or signature until a compile of its current bytes passes; only a log whose compile passed is bound to its saved state (revision 6, R-2).

add.label: Save document
add.note: Writes an open document's bytes to its file, whole and atomically, and records the digest of the saved bytes (ADR-D01.79, revision 6's R-3). Saving the live session's tab writes the session as a log of the 1.0 format. It changes no live state; nothing is written to a document's file until the solver saves.

add.label: Save document as
add.note: Writes an open document's bytes to the file named and makes that file the document's identity (ADR-D01.79). It changes no live state.

add.label: Compile document
add.note: Compiles an open document as a job (ADR-D01.81): a script is parsed, checked and lowered; a log runs the gates format, model_match, moves (every move replayed with its legal witness), final_hash, macros and scripts. The result is bound to the SHA-256 of the bytes it compiled, so any edit makes it stale (revision 6, R-2). It never changes live state and never runs a script.

add.label: Close document
add.note: Closes an open document's tab (ADR-D01.79). The live session's tab is always there and does not close. A dirty document closes only with discard, which drops its unsaved contents; its file is not touched. It changes no live state.

set.note: Writes the live session as a log file in the format named: the 1.0 log (ADR-D01.80), or 0.4's C600 proof log and an MPUlt v1 log of 600-cell-Full as interchange (ADR-D01.84). It changes no live state.

amend.source: ADR-D01.82 (ADR-D01-rev5-documents.md; owner, 23 Nov 2026): export follows the redesigned log rows

set.note: Checks a log file as a job, a 1.0 log or a C600 or MPUlt interchange file (ADR-D01.81, .84): its format and model identity (model_match), every move replayed with its legal witness and the final full-state hash. The result is bound to the SHA-256 of the bytes it read, which file.log.import's file check names. It changes no live state and runs no script.

amend.source: ADR-D01.82 (ADR-D01-rev5-documents.md; owner, 23 Nov 2026): the check is the import's file-check gate

expect.note: keeps preferences; leaves a recovery checkpoint

set.note: Makes a checked log the current session: the explicit import commit (ADR-D01.82). It needs a passed file.log.check of the file's current bytes (file_check) and the solver's confirmation (confirm). Before it commits, a recovery checkpoint of the live session is written. It commits the log's saved state as one undoable journal entry, so session.undo returns to the state before it, and it keeps the current preferences: the log's are recorded, never applied (ADR-D01.80). Embedded scripts never run.

amend.source: ADR-D01.82 (ADR-D01-rev5-documents.md; owner, 23 Nov 2026): the import commit's gates, recovery checkpoint, undo journal and kept preferences; the commit replays a checked plan and runs no job
